description: This file defines a utility class 'FeignCalls' with static methods to execute Feign client calls safely, handling exceptions and simplifying call execution within the project.

classes.name: FeignCalls
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for executing Feign client calls with exception handling.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Executes a Feign call expecting a successful response, returning the response body or throwing a wrapped exception on failure.

methods.name: executeVoid
methods.description: Executes a Feign call that returns void, throwing a wrapped exception if the call fails.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a Feign call and returns the response, allowing the caller to handle exceptions directly.
